events.text: Standing rule for group bookings of more than 30 people: take a 25% deposit within 14 days of confirming the dates, otherwise the dates go back on the calendar.

Any supplier order over 800 needs sign-off from Marisol, our finance lead, before it is placed.
Heads up: the Old Barn toilet block gets repainted the week of 20 to 24 July, so it will be closed that week. The shower block by reception stays open.
Price list for the season: seasoned logs at 9 per bag, delivered free anywhere on site.

Drainage renewal on Lakeside Field: we will have the field closed from Friday 4 September to Friday 18 September 2026. Gates locked and no pitches in use for that whole period. We hand the field back on the 18th.
We'd like Lakeside Field for our autumn weekend, Saturday 12 to Sunday 13 September — 60 people, and we'd need a marquee for the Saturday evening meal.
Checked the diary: Meadow Slope is free that weekend if you need it. Just remember it has no water hookup, unlike Lakeside Field.
Club rate for groups is 14 per person per night, that's the figure we quote walking clubs.

I'm free the evening of Saturday 5 September if you want the autumn bat walk then — 19:30 start on the Woodland Trail works well.

August mowing plan: front meadows weekly, Woodland Trail edges cut the last week of August.

The Riverside Walking Club weekend of 12 and 13 September moves from Lakeside Field to Meadow Slope, since the drainage closure runs right over their dates. Sixty people, same 14 per person per night rate. Internal schedule updated and the warden informed.

Site notice: Lakeside Field closed for drainage works, 4 to 18 September. Walkers please use the Woodland Trail instead.
